34729-how-to-prosper-in-boll-weevil-terr.title: How To Prosper In Boll Weevil Territory
34729-how-to-prosper-in-boll-weevil-terr.creator: Unknown
34729-how-to-prosper-in-boll-weevil-terr.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. In order to obtain profitable returns from farming in boll weevil territory, we must--First, grow an early crop of cotton; second, use every means possible to destroy the weevil and reduce their number to a minimum; third, follow a system of diversified farming.

arxiv-2006-04442.title: Temporally semidiscrete approximation of a Dirichlet boundary control for a fractional/normal evolution equation with a final observation Thanks: This work was supported by National Natural Science Foundation of China (11901410).
arxiv-2006-04442.creator: Qin Zhou and Binjie Li School of Mathematics, Sichuan University
arxiv-2006-04442.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Qin Zhou and Binjie Li School of Mathematics, Sichuan University. Optimal Dirichlet boundary control for a fractional/normal evolution with a final observation is considered. The unique existence of the solution and the first-order optimality condition of the optimal control problem are derived. The convergence of a temporally semidiscrete approximation is rigorously established, where the control is not explicitly discretized and the state equation is discretized by a discontinuous Galerkin method in time. Numerical results are provided to verify the theoretical results.

arxiv-2203-05918.title: Integrating Dependency Tree Into Self-attention for Sentence Representation
arxiv-2203-05918.creator: Junhua Ma, Jiajun Li, Yuxuan Liu, Shangbo Zhou, Xue Li
arxiv-2203-05918.description: Abstract Recent progress on parse tree encoder for sentence representation learning is notable. However, these works mainly encode tree structures recursively, which is not conducive to parallelization. On the other hand, these works rarely take into account the labels of arcs in dependency trees.

arxiv-2302-07329.title: Normality of minimal log canonical centers of threefolds in mixed and positive characteristic
arxiv-2302-07329.creator: Emelie Arvidsson and Quentin Posva
arxiv-2302-07329.description: Abstract Abstract. We prove the normality of minimal log canonical centers on threefold pairs which residue fields are perfect of residue characteristics p\neq 2,3 and 5 . We also show that the union of all log canonical centers on threefold pairs with standard coefficients are seminormal provided that the residue characteristic is large enough.

arxiv-2305-04406.title: PolyTO: Structural Topology Optimization using Convex Polygons
arxiv-2305-04406.creator: Aaditya Chandrasekhar
arxiv-2305-04406.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Aaditya Chandrasekhar. In this paper, we propose a topology optimization (TO) framework where the design is parameterized by a set of convex polygons. Extending feature mapping methods in TO, the representation allows for direct extraction of the geometry. In addition, the method allows one to impose geometric constraints such as feature size control directly on the polygons that are otherwise difficult to impose in density or level set based approaches.

arxiv-2305-05690.title: Exploring the spectrum of stochastic gravitational-wave anisotropies with pulsar timing arrays
arxiv-2305-05690.creator: Gabriela Sato-Polito, Marc Kamionkowski
arxiv-2305-05690.description: Abstract Anisotropies in the nanohertz gravitational-wave background are a compelling next target for pulsar timing arrays (PTAs). Measurements or informative upper limits to the anisotropies are expected in the near future and can offer important clues about the origin of the background and the properties of the sources.

arxiv-2305-16588.title: Legion: Automatically Pushing the Envelope of Multi-GPU System for Billion-Scale GNN Training
arxiv-2305-16588.creator: Jie Sun, Li Su, Zuocheng Shi, Wenting Shen, Zeke Wang, Lei Wang, Jie Zhang, Yong Li, Wenyuan Yu, Jingren Zhou, Fei Wu
arxiv-2305-16588.description: Abstract Graph neural network(GNN) has been widely applied in real-world applications, such as product recommendation in e-commerce platforms and risk control in financial management systems. Several cache-based GNN systems have been built to accelerate GNN training in a single machine with multiple GPUs. However, these systems fail to train billion-scale graphs efficiently, which is a common challenge in the industry.

arxiv-2403-04384.title: HeROS: a miniaturised platform for research and development on Heterogeneous RObotic Systems
arxiv-2403-04384.creator: Tomasz Winiarski [0000-0002-9316-3284], Daniel Giełdowski [0000-0002-4348-2981], Jan Kaniuka [0009-0009-9379-4906], Jakub Ostrysz [0009-0006-8178-0134], Jakub Sadowski
arxiv-2403-04384.description: Abstract Tests and prototyping are vital in the research and development of robotic systems. Work with target hardware is problematic. Hence, in the article, a low-cost, miniaturised physical platform is presented to deal with experiments on heterogeneous robotic systems. The platform comprises a physical board with tiles of the standardised base, diverse mobile robots, and manipulation robots.

arxiv-2403-17726.title: Tiny Models are the Computational Saver for Large Models
arxiv-2403-17726.creator: Qingyuan Wang, Barry Cardiff, Antoine Frappé, Benoit Larras, Deepu John
arxiv-2403-17726.description: Abstract This paper introduces TinySaver, an early-exit-like dynamic model compression approach which employs tiny models to substitute large models adaptively. Distinct from traditional compression techniques, dynamic methods like TinySaver can leverage the difficulty differences to allow certain inputs to complete their inference processes early, thereby conserving computational resources.

arxiv-2411-11251.title: Black Hole Scaling Relations in the Dwarf-galaxy Regime with Gaia -Sausage/Enceladus and ω \omega Centauri
arxiv-2411-11251.creator: Guilherme Limberg
arxiv-2411-11251.description: Abstract The discovery of fast moving stars in Milky Way’s most massive globular cluster, ω \omega Centauri ( ω ​ Cen \omega{\rm Cen} ), has provided strong evidence for an intermediate-mass black hole (IMBH) inside of it. However, ω ​ Cen \omega{\rm Cen} is known to be the stripped nuclear star cluster (NSC) of an ancient, now-destroyed, dwarf galaxy.

arxiv-2506-12620.title: Regular Spacetimes in the Effective Metric Description
arxiv-2506-12620.creator: Mattia Damia Paciarini, Mikołaj Myszkowski, Francesco Sannino, Vania Vellucci
arxiv-2506-12620.description: Abstract Over the past few decades, significant effort has been directed towards developing various regularized models for compact objects. Recently, a new observable-based parametrization was introduced to account for black hole deformations in a model-independent fashion, referred to as the Effective Metric Description (EMD) [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] .

arxiv-2507-23009.title: Stop Evaluating AI with Human Tests, Develop Principled, AI-specific Tests instead
arxiv-2507-23009.creator: Tom Sühr, Florian E. Dorner, Olawale Salaudeen, Augustin Kelava, Samira Samadi
arxiv-2507-23009.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable results on a range of standardized tests originally designed to assess human cognitive and psychological traits, such as intelligence and personality. While these results are often interpreted as strong evidence of human-like characteristics in LLMs, this paper argues that such interpretations constitute an ontological error.

pmc-11481644.creator: Tobias A. Thomas, Katja Tilk, Katharina Klassen, Melanie Pommnitz, Ruth Wunder, Julian W. Mall, Hinrich Köhler, Martina de Zwaan, Günther Meyer, Thomas P. Hüttl, Astrid Müller
pmc-11481644.description: PurposePrevious research on obesity surgery (OS) showed that patients do not only experience weight loss but also improvements in certain mental health outcomes (e.g., depression) after OS. However, self-harm behaviors might increase after OS. Regarding self-harm, the literature is mostly limited to studies using data from hospital or emergency room charts.

pmc-11608331.title: AutoLDT: a lightweight spatio-temporal decoupling transformer framework with AutoML method for time series classification
pmc-11608331.creator: Peng Wang, Ke Wang, Yafei Song, Xiaodan Wang
pmc-11608331.description: Time series classification finds widespread applications in civil, industrial, and military fields, while the classification performance of time series models has been improving with the recent development of deep learning. However, the issues of feature extraction effectiveness, model complexity, and model design uncertainty constrain the further development of time series classification.

pmc-12473109.title: Unlocking the Alkaloid Biological Potential of Chili Pepper (Capsicum spp.), Cacao (Theobroma cacao L.), and Coffee (Coffea spp.) Byproducts: Characterization, Non-Conventional Extraction, Applications, and Future Perspectives
pmc-12473109.creator: Anahí Cárdenas, Luis Mojica, Luis Coronado-Cáceres, Gustavo A Castillo-Herrera, Spyridon Petropoulos
pmc-12473109.description: Chili peppers (Capsicum spp.), cacao (Theobroma cacao L.), and coffee (Coffea spp.) are important crops worldwide. Nearly 35%, 80%, and 45% of the respective fruits are underutilized or discarded, representing a considerable economic loss. This work reviews and analyzes the environmental factors that influence the concentration of the main alkaloids in these crops, including capsaicin, theobromine, and caffeine.

pmc-12648314.title: Autonomous Bioluminescence Systems: From Molecular Mechanisms to Emerging Applications
pmc-12648314.creator: Subhan Hadi Kusuma, Mitsuru Hattori, Takeharu Nagai
pmc-12648314.description: Autonomous bioluminescence systemsgenetically encoded platforms that integrate luciferase enzymes with complete substrate biosynthetic pathwayshave emerged as transformative tools for real-time, noninvasive imaging in living systems. Unlike conventional substrate-dependent bioluminescence, these systems provide continuous light emission without external substrates, enabling long-term monitoring with minimal phototoxicity compared to the use of fluorescence.

pmc-12764030.title: Effects of lower limb neural mobilisation on reactive agility, balance, and physical performance: a randomised controlled trial
pmc-12764030.creator: Selim Mahmut Gunay, Ece Erturk
pmc-12764030.description: PurposeNeural mobilization (NM) is commonly applied to enhance neural tissue mobility and reduce pain, but its effects on physical performance in healthy individuals remain uncertain. This randomised controlled trial investigated the effects of lower limb NM, applied alone or in combination with dynamic stretching, on reactive agility (RA), balance, flexibility, and muscle strength in healthy young women.

pmc-13107584.title: Effects of antihypertensive therapy on matrix metalloproteinase-9 levels in controlled hypertensive patients
pmc-13107584.creator: José Fernando Vilela-Martin, Tatiana Palotta Minari, Marco Antônio Vieira da Silva, Valquíria da Silva Lopes, Kléber Aparecido de Oliveira, Marco Aurélio de Almeida, Riccardo Lacchini, José Eduardo Tanus-Santos, Heitor Moreno, Juan Carlos Yugar-Toledo, Luciana Neves Cosenso-Martin
pmc-13107584.description: Ambulatory blood pressure monitoring (ABPM), alongside peripheral blood pressure (BP) measurements, provides valuable insights into central hemodynamics, including pulse wave velocity (PWV), augmentation index (AI75%), and central pressure—factors closely linked to arterial stiffness. The progression of arterial stiffness is associated with matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9), an extracellular matrix enzyme.

pmc-13111675.title: A study on the efficacy and safety of fecal microbiota transplantation as an adjunctive therapy for treating depressive episodes
pmc-13111675.creator: Linlin Wang, Sijia Zhang, Yiyun Liu, Deqiang Li, Guoqiang Tian, Xujuan Li, Yufeng Li
pmc-13111675.description: This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) as an adjunctive therapy for depressive episodes. This study recruited 46 participants aged 18–65 from January 2022 to December 2023 who were diagnosed with depression according to the International Classification of Diseases, 10th edition.

pmc-13199402.title: Emergent surface magnetic ordering and surface electronic dipole layers in a two-dimensional spin=1/2 La2CuO4 film
pmc-13199402.creator: Anjali Jain, Caozheng Diao, Bin Leong Ong, Angga Dito Fauzi, Kaushik Jayaraman, Muhammad Avicenna Naradipa, Sai Prashanth Josyula, Xiao Chi, Thomas James Whitcher, Muhandis Shiddiq, Mark B H Breese, Eng Soon Tok, Andrivo Rusydi
pmc-13199402.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The surfaces of strongly correlated materials can exhibit exotic properties that differ substantially from the bulk. Investigation of these surface effects requires both high quality surfaces, and an experimental technique capable of disentangling surface and underneath layers or bulk. Herein, we overcome these two challenges, using newly developed grazing-incident-angle resonant soft x-ray and magnetic scattering techniques to study ultrathin films of Spin(S) = 1/2 La2CuO4, the parent compound of high-critical-temperature (high-Tc) superconductor.

pmc-13391471.creator: Yusuff Adebayo Adebisi, Nick Bailey, Angela Henderson, Chris Dibben, Serena Pattaro
pmc-13391471.description: BackgroundDisabled people experienced disproportionately poor outcomes during the COVID-19 pandemic, but evidence remains uneven across disability status and across stages of the disease pathway. pmc-13531141.title: TROP2 Expression in Bladder Transurethral Resection Specimens: Correlation With Histological Grade and Survival
pmc-13531141.creator: ÖZGECAN GÜNDOĞAR, SİBEL BEKTAŞ, BURAK ARSLAN, PELİN AKBAŞ
pmc-13531141.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/AimTROP2 has become a therapeutic target in urothelial carcinoma following the approval of TROP2-directed antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), yet its expression in transurethral resection (TURBT) material remains poorly characterized. This study aimed to evaluate TROP2 protein expression using immunohistochemistry (IHC) in bladder TURBT samples and to investigate its association with histological grade, tumor stage, lymphovascular invasion (LVI), carcinoma in situ (CIS), recurrence, and survival outcomes.Materials and MethodsA total of 79 bladder TURBT specimens were included.

pmc-13605284.title: Breast–Ovarian Hereditary Cancer Syndrome: Beyond BRCA1 and BRCA2
pmc-13605284.creator: Evgeny Imyanitov, Anna Sokolenko
pmc-13605284.description: Simple SummaryWomen with breast cancer (BC) or ovarian cancer (OC) routinely receive germline DNA testing for diagnosis of hereditary cancer syndromes. This testing was confined to BRCA1 and BRCA2 genes in the past, however, current technologies allow simultaneous analysis of a number of additional genes for the same cost.
